summary: AudioCodes filed a Form 6-K disclosing board adoption of a Rule 10b5-1 stock trading plan authorizing repurchases of ordinary shares during periods when insider-trading rules or self-imposed blackouts would otherwise bar buying. Repurchases are subject to Rule 10b-18 price, volume and timing constraints, with an independent broker granted discretion to buy under board-specified price parameters. No share count, dollar authorization, price per share or expiration date is stated. The plan is a buyback mechanic, not a tender offer; watch subsequent 20-F/6-K disclosure for authorization size and execution pace as a signal of management's valuation view.
